B: each text has four blanks.

questions.stem: What should you check first when inserting a sentence into a paragraph?
choices: The logical link with the sentences before and after
Whether it starts with a capital letter

fr.rule: Le lien logique avec le contexte immédiat prime.
why_wrong: B : toutes les phrases commencent par une majuscule.

en.rule: The logical link with the immediate context comes first.
why_wrong: B: all sentences start with a capital.

questions.stem: An inserted sentence begins with 'However,'. What does this tell you?
choices: It is the first sentence of the text
The previous sentence expresses an idea that this one contrasts
The previous sentence is a list

fr.rule: However introduit un contraste avec la phrase précédente.
why_wrong: A : un connecteur d'opposition suppose une phrase précédente.
fr.example: It is cheap; however, it is slow.

en.rule: However introduces a contrast with the previous sentence.
why_wrong: A: a contrast connector assumes a previous sentence.
en.example: It is cheap; however, it is slow.

questions.stem: In what order is it best to answer Part 6 blanks?
choices: Strictly in order, no matter what
Grammar blanks first, sentence insertion last

why_wrong: C : plus long, à garder pour la fin.
A: order is not always optimal.
C: longer, better kept for last.

questions.stem: Why must the tense be consistent across a Part 6 text?
choices: Because the choices are all in the same tense
The text has a single time frame (date, event)

fr.rule: Le contexte temporel du texte impose le temps.
why_wrong: B : ce n'est pas la raison.
fr.example: The meeting will be held on Friday.

en.rule: The time context of the text determines the tense.
why_wrong: B: that is not the reason.
en.example: The meeting will be held on Friday.

questions.stem: What should you check first in a sentence-insertion question?
choices: The logical link with the sentences before and after

questions.stem: A sentence starts with 'However,' but the previous sentence continues the same idea. What is wrong?

why_wrong: B : Il y a une contradiction.

questions.stem: In which order is it efficient to answer Part 6 blanks?
choices: Grammar blanks first, sentence insertion last

why_wrong: C : L'insertion demande le plus de temps.
